facts.fact: Le Patriote reports that a connection failure in several arrondissement offices of Cotonou on Friday 11 September 2026 stopped the registering and validating of Droit Taxi payments, leaving motorcycle-taxi drivers waiting for hours; it gives no count of offices or drivers and names no provider.

Le Patriote states that Cotonou's arrondissement offices, sub-offices of the commune, register and validate Droit Taxi payments at the counter over a connection, such that its failure on 11 September 2026 blocked payment for the day; the payment system and its operator are not named.

systems.tiers: several arrondissement offices of the commune of Cotonou

systems.owner: municipal authorities of Cotonou, as the article addresses them; the operator is not named
systems.tiers: arrondissement offices of Cotonou, at the counter

note: The offices are arrondissements, sub-offices of one commune, Cotonou; who provides the connection is not stated, so no fact is given for how the office is connected.
